entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage and planeswalker who searches Markov Manor for a lead on Sorin Markov and finds a journal explaining Avacyn's origin.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker, one of the three who imprisoned the Eldrazi on Zendikar, who according to the journal made the angel Avacyn; his whereabouts are unknown.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer planeswalker whose warnings Jace recalls and whose voice he imagines in the manor.

entities.name: Edgar Markov
entities.description: The ancestor of all Innistrad's vampires and builder of the manor, shown in sculpture and in Jace's visions holding a knife over a bound angel.

entities.name: Jenrik
entities.description: A human who took over a moonfolk planeswalker's journal and was sent to Markov Manor, where he died and was entombed in stone clutching it.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Innistrad's angel of purity and goodness, who according to the journal was made by Sorin to protect humans; the angels she rules have turned on the people.

entities.name: Markov Manor
entities.description: The ancestral home of Sorin and the Markov vampires, torn apart and left hanging over a chasm with vampires petrified in its walls.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane of werewolves, vampires and angels where Jace is searching for Sorin.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane where Jace climbed hedrons and where Sorin failed to appear.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane from which the moonfolk author of the journal comes.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: World-devouring creatures imprisoned on Zendikar by Sorin and two other planeswalkers.

entities.name: Jenrik's Journal
entities.description: A book wrapped in blue leather with a red and green silk strap, written in part by a moonfolk planeswalker, which explains that Sorin made Avacyn.

entities.name: Cryptoliths
entities.description: Twisted stones that manipulate mana flow; a moonfolk planeswalker explains a theory about them in Jace's vision.

entities.name: Vampires
entities.description: The vampires of Markov Manor, the heirs of Edgar Markov, now petrified in the walls.

entities.name: Angels of Innistrad
entities.description: The winged beings ruled by Avacyn, who according to Jace's deduction have gone mad and turned on humans.

events.summary: Jace arrives at the shattered Markov Manor, hanging apart over a chasm with a broken bridge of stepping stones.
events.quote: Jace stood at the end of a long arched bridge that jutted out from the mountainside.

events.summary: Jace is briefly shown a vision of the manor as it once was; he cannot detect any mind causing it.
events.quote: Suddenly, he saw the place as it must have once been

events.summary: Jace uses telekinesis and balance to cross the floating stones to the entrance.
events.quote: He stepped off the edge of the bridge and planted his foot on a stone that hung in the air.

events.summary: Jace enters the manor's archway, carved with monsters and a giant vampire.
events.quote: He stepped into the archway and the stone walls enfolded him.

events.summary: A voice breaks the silence in the entry hall, asking Jace why he came; he cannot find its source.
events.quote: "Why did you come here?" A voice breaks the silence.

events.summary: Jace sees a memory of another living man in the hall and learns he is not the first living person there recently.
events.quote: I'm not the first living man to set foot in this hall recently.

events.summary: Jace finds a great hall of floating rubble with dozens of petrified vampires embedded in the stone.
events.quote: Dozens and dozens of them, trapped and petrified and encased in the stone.

events.summary: Jace experiences the dead man's memory of vampires grabbing him, with Edgar Markov approaching.
events.quote: I step back and suddenly there are hands all around me, clutching at me.

events.summary: Jace finds the dead man's stone face and the journal he clutches to his chest.
events.quote: It's wrapped in blue leather, held shut with a red and green strap of silk.

events.summary: Jace realizes the journal was written by a moonfolk planeswalker from Kamigawa and that Jenrik took it over and was sent to the manor to die.
events.quote: after she entrusted the journal to him and sent him here.

events.summary: Jace witnesses a vision of Edgar Markov and twelve vampires opening an angel's veins and drinking her silver blood at an altar, perhaps the birth of Innistrad's vampires.
events.quote: The knife slashes and glowing silver blood erupts from the angel's neck.

events.summary: Jace reads in the journal that Sorin made Avacyn to protect humans so that vampires would not overfeed.
Jace concludes that the angels have gone mad and turned on the humans, and someone tore apart the manor.
events.quote: The angels have turned on the human populace.

events.summary: Jace resolves that the journal will help him find Sorin through the angels.
events.quote: This will help me find Sorin.

events.summary: Jace deduces that Jenrik brought the journal, was about to be caught by the vampires, and that someone tore the castle apart and trapped them all in the walls.
events.quote: Jenrik came to the castle carrying the journal

events.summary: Jace leaves Markov Manor with the journal.
events.quote: I turn my back on the darkness, pass through the soaring entryway, and leave Markov Manor.

relations.note: According to the journal, Sorin made Avacyn to protect humans.
It is his ancestral home, where he is reportedly unwelcome.
relations.quote: Liliana had suggested that he wasn't particularly welcome in his ancestral home.

relations.note: Jace takes him for the ancestor of all Innistrad's vampires.
relations.quote: the ancestor of all Innistrad's vampires

relations.note: He concedes that her warnings about the manor were right.
One of three planeswalkers who imprisoned the Eldrazi on Zendikar.
relations.quote: one of the three Planeswalkers who imprisoned the Eldrazi on Zendikar thousands of years ago
